units.source_text: 这个叫拉卟的河童对我的照顾并不比巴咯少，最让我心存感谢的是它把一个叫托喀的河童介绍给我。

en.t: This kappa named Rappu took no less care of me than Baggu did, and what made me most grateful was that he introduced me to a kappa named Tokka.

units.source_text: 托喀留着长发，是河童诗人，在这一点上跟我们人类差不多。

en.t: Tokka wore his hair long and was a kappa poet; in that respect he was much like us human beings.

units.source_text: 我为了消遣时间，经常到托喀家去玩。

en.t: To pass the time, I often went to Tokka's house to visit.

units.source_text: 托喀的房子很是窄小，房子里总是摆着一排盆栽的高山植物，

en.t: Tokka's house was very small and cramped, and inside there was always a row of potted alpine plants,

units.source_text: 他一边写诗一边抽烟，过得相当舒服惬意。

en.t: while he wrote poems and smoked, living in considerable comfort and ease.

units.source_text: 房间的一角，一只雌河童（托喀崇尚自由恋爱，因此不结婚）在织毛线活什么的。

en.t: In one corner of the room, a female kappa, since Tokka believed in free love and therefore did not marry, was knitting or doing something of the sort.

units.source_text: 托喀看见我，就微笑着说（不过，河童笑起来不怎么好看，至少刚开始看的时候我觉得很可怕）：

en.t: When Tokka saw me, he smiled and said, though a kappa's smile is not especially attractive, and at least when I first saw it I found it frightening:
"Ah, a very warm welcome. Please sit down."
